market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool has finished top‑4 in 4 of the last 5 seasons and retains a top‑class squad. The managerial change adds uncertainty, but the underlying player quality and club infrastructure suggest a ~62% chance of top‑4. The market’s 52.5% price underrates their true odds, creating value on Yes.
evidence_points: Finished top‑4 in 4 of last 5 EPL seasons (3rd in 23/24, 2nd in 21/22, 3rd in 20/21).
Squad includes elite players like Salah, Alisson, Van Dijk, Alexander‑Arnold – sufficient to compete for top places.
Arne Slot’s appointment represents a transition, but Feyenoord’s performance indicates managerial competence; risk of drop‑off is real but not enough to push probability below 60%.
sources_consulted: Reports on Jürgen Klopp’s departure and Arne Slot appointment
